simple.summary: תִּירָס (Tîyrâç) means Tiras , a son of Japheth First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 5.

definitions.full: H8494. Tiras תִּירָ֑ס proper name, of a territory and people 'son' of Japhet Gen 10:2 ; 1Chr 1:5 ; Θειρας ; identified by Mey Geschichte. d. Alt. i.260 Di Holz Gunk and others with Greek Τυρσηνοί , Egyptian Turuša , on coast of gean.
